name: Ahl al-Kitāb
definition: The People of the Book: Jews and Christians, addressed in the Qur'an.

name: Aḥruf
definition: The modes in which the Qur'an was revealed, allowing recitation in more than one form.

name: al-Zabūr
definition: The revelation given to David, usually understood as the Psalms {Q 4:163}.

name: Atonement
definition: The Christian doctrine that Christ's death pays for the sins of others. The Qur'an teaches that no soul bears another's burden {Q 53:38}.

name: Āya
definition: A verse of the Qur'an; also a sign.

name: Canon
definition: The list of books a community accepts as scripture.

name: Comma Johanneum
definition: The 'three witnesses in heaven' of 1 John 5:7, absent from the early Greek manuscripts.

name: Ḍaʿīf
definition: Weak: a hadith with a defect in its chain or text.

name: Diatessaron
definition: Tatian's single Gospel woven from the four, c. 170 CE, used in the Syriac churches for centuries.

name: Dīn al-ḥanīf
definition: The primordial religion of pure monotheism, taught by every prophet {Q 30:30}.

name: Fiṭra
definition: The natural disposition God places in every human to know Him.

name: Furqān
definition: Criterion, that which separates truth from falsehood. Applied to the Qur'an and also to the revelation given to Moses.

name: Hadith
definition: A report of the words or actions of the Prophet, preserved through a chain of narrators.

name: Ḥasan
definition: Good: a grade just below sound.

name: Ḥawāriyyūn
definition: The disciples of Jesus, who declared themselves helpers in God's cause {Q 3:52}.

name: Injil
definition: The revelation God gave Jesus. Always singular in the Qur'an; not the four Gospels.

name: Isnād
definition: The chain of narrators by which a hadith is transmitted.

name: Masoretic Text
definition: The standard Hebrew text, fixed by Jewish scholars between about the 7th and 10th centuries.

name: Muhaymin
definition: Guardian, witness, trusted arbiter. The Qur'an's description of itself over the earlier books {Q 5:48}.

name: Muṣaddiq
definition: One who attests the truth of what came before. Used of the Qur'an, and of Jesus confirming the Torah.

name: Muṣḥaf
definition: A bound copy of the Qur'an.

name: Nabī
definition: A prophet. Muslims hold there was none between Jesus and Muhammad.

name: Pericope adulterae
definition: The story of the woman taken in adultery, John 7:53–8:11, absent from the earliest manuscripts.

name: Peshitta
definition: The Syriac Bible. Its New Testament has 22 books.

name: Pseudepigraphy
definition: Writing under another person's name. Most scholars think several letters in Paul's name are pseudepigraphic.

name: Qira’at
definition: The recognised readings of the Qur'an, each traced to the Prophet, differing in vowels, dots and a few words.

name: Rajm
definition: Stoning, the penalty for adultery in the Torah and in the hadith about the Jews of Medina.

name: Rasūl
definition: A messenger: a prophet who brings a scripture.

name: Ṣaḥīḥ
definition: Sound: the highest grade for a hadith. Also the title of the collections of al-Bukhārī and Muslim.

name: Septuagint
definition: The Greek translation of the Hebrew scriptures, begun in the 3rd century BCE.

name: Shahāda
definition: The testimony of faith: 'There is no god but God, and Muhammad is the messenger of God.'

name: Ṣuḥuf
definition: Scrolls. The Qur'an speaks of the scrolls of Abraham and Moses {Q 87:19}.

name: Sūra
definition: A chapter of the Qur'an. There are 114.

name: Tafsīr
definition: Commentary on the Qur'an. Major works include al-Ṭabarī, Ibn Kathīr and al-Rāzī.

name: Taḥrīf
definition: Distortion. Classically divided into distortion of wording (*lafẓ*) and of meaning (*maʿnā*).

name: Taḥrīf al-lafẓ
definition: Distortion of the wording of a text.

name: Taḥrīf al-maʿnā
definition: Distortion of the meaning, by misreading or explaining away.

name: Taṣdīq
definition: Confirmation: declaring true, verifying, putting right. Applied to a message or a prophet, not to a manuscript.

name: Tawātur
definition: Transmission by so many that collusion is impossible. The basis of the Qur'an's certain text.

name: Tawḥīd
definition: The oneness of God: the centre of Islam.

name: Textual criticism
definition: The study of manuscripts to work out what an original text said.

name: Torah
definition: The revelation given to Moses. Singular in the Qur'an; not a multi-book canon.

name: Trinity
definition: The Christian doctrine, formulated in the fourth century, that God is three persons in one being. The Qur'an rejects it {Q 4:171}.

name: Uthmanic codex
definition: The standard copy made under ʿUthmān around 650 CE, from which copies were sent to the major cities.
